$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFRE (AIP France, chart dated 2025-07-10): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Baule-Escoublac

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

service.atsHours: AFIS du 15 au 30 juin et du 1er au 15 septembre : 0900-1100 et 1400-1700 du 1er juillet au 31 août : 0900-1130 et 1400-1800. from 15th to 30th june and from 01st to 15th september: 0900-1100 and 1400-1700 from 01st july to 31th august: 0900-1130 and 1400-1800. Aérodrome de la Baule Escoublac, 44500 la Baule (UTC HIV ; HOR ETE : -1HR)

notes: Air navigation hazard The attention of pilots is drawn to the proximity of CTR SAINT NAZAIRE in order to avoid any entry in class D airspace without clearance.
AD likely to be covered by sea haze in few minutes.
Presence of an obstacle (weather mast) H24 lighting 140 ft AMSL, R 090 / 210 m of the tower.
Radio contact is mandatory in the AFIS volume 3 NM / 2000 ft.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
CAT B ACFT taxiing is restricted beyond AVT stands.
Stands with parking cables, numbers 1 to 14 on P1 reserved for CAT A ACFT.
From P1 to hangars, TXL reserved only for home-based ACFT.
P2 reserved for CAT B ACFT and helicopters.
It's recommended to overfly regional park of Brière above 1000 ft.
Noise abatment procedure: to minimise nuisances, take-off RWY 11 and landing RWY 29 is preferred according to weather conditions and traffics.
Traffic pattern: in QFU 106° and 286°, flown only North of the RWY; prohibited from 1100 to 1300 and after 1800 (SUM: - 1 HR).; prohibited on SUN and public HOL for non-based.
For helicopters, mandatory radio messages before startup.
TWY B1 only usable to vacate RWY.
PJE on AD (NR 277): see AIP ENR 5.5
